scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; for (const p of ['dist','template-zip']) fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true}); console.log('✅ clean: dist/ y template-zip/ eliminados');"
scripts.zip:prepare: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; import path from 'node:path'; const root=process.cwd(); const out=path.join(root,'template-zip'); fs.rmSync(out,{recursive:true,force:true}); fs.mkdirSync(out,{recursive:true}); const keep=['src','public','index.html','package.json','vite.config.js','vite.config.ts','postcss.config.js','postcss.config.cjs','tailwind.config.js','tailwind.config.cjs','README.md','LICENSE','DISCLAIMER.md','CHANGELOG.md','.gitignore','.env.example']; for (const k of keep){ const p=path.join(root,k); if(!fs.existsSync(p)) continue; const dest=path.join(out,k); const stat=fs.statSync(p); if(stat.isDirectory()) fs.cpSync(p,dest,{recursive:true}); else fs.copyFileSync(p,dest); } console.log('✅ template-zip/ listo (sin node_modules)');"
scripts.zip:test: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Remove-Item -Recurse -Force .\\_zipfinaltest -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force .\\_zipfinaltest | Out-Null; Expand-Archive -Path .\\el-enlace-starter-v1.0.0.zip -DestinationPath .\\_zipfinaltest -Force"
